options.text_cn: 王在棋盘中心被多个棋子包围将死
options.text_en: The king is checkmated in the center of the board by several pieces

options.text_cn: 马将军，且王的所有逃格都被己方棋子堵死
options.text_en: A knight gives check while the king's own pieces block every escape square
Two rooks line up to checkmate the king

options.text_cn: 王在底线被车沿横线将死
options.text_en: The king is checkmated by a rook along the back rank

explanation_cn: 闷杀指马给王将军，而王的所有逃格都被自己的棋子堵住，无路可逃。王通常躲在角落，被己方的车、兵封死，马从侧面一跳致命。
explanation_en: A smothered mate is delivered by a knight when the king's own pieces block every escape square. The king is often trapped in a corner by its own rooks and pawns, allowing the knight to deliver the final check.
